title: Fix flaky retry logic missing backoff/max-attempts
description: call_with_retry(fn, max_attempts) in retry.py accepts a max_attempts parameter but never enforces it - it loops forever ('while True') until fn() succeeds. Bound the loop to max_attempts and return a structured {"success": False, "attempts": n, "error": ...} result when all attempts are exhausted, instead of retrying indefinitely.
